target: Explore a single actual 4x4 compression of the known explicit 4x5 PPT/SN3 grid state, using a Bob kernel vector with ALL five coordinates nonzero. This is not an all-state proof or witness.
local_map: K fixes Bob |0>,|1>,|2>, sends |3> to (|0>+|1>+|2>+|3>)/4 and sends |4> to |3>. Its kernel is span{(-1,-1,-1,4,-1)}. The state is (I tensor K)R(I tensor K)^* with R from frontier-20261028-grid-state-five-projections-v1.json; it is physical and PPT by the exact parent-state certificate and local congruence. Its SN is not established here.
exact_rank2_parameterization: For v0=v1=v2=lambda=1/4 and arbitrary Gaussian-rational alpha,beta,b,f with alpha*f!=0, set a=1, d=v1 f-alpha b-beta, c=(1+v2 f-beta b)/alpha, e=alpha+beta d-v0 f, h=lambda f/alpha, gamma=(lambda e+c)/h, delta=v1 e-gamma b, i=gamma c+delta b-v2 e, g=gamma+delta d-v0 e. Then the projected Eq.11 matrix has row2=alpha*row0+beta*row1 and row3=gamma*row0+delta*row1 exactly, so its complex Schmidt rank is at most2. This gives a constructive exact atom chart, not an exhaustive characterization of all rank2 atoms.

experiments.observed: 384 numerically generated approximate rank2 atoms plus eight exact basis atoms; maximum accepted singular3/singular1 9.95542094961384e-09, floating feature-fit relative residual 1.9864456744873645e-09. Neither the atoms nor the weights certify an exact decomposition.
1772 exact Fraction rank<=2 atoms, 10000-iteration numerical nonnegative fit, relative residual 0.060144425573075484; finite-chart numerical miss is not a no-go.

3008 exact Gaussian-rational rank<=2 atoms, 8000-iteration numerical nonnegative fit, relative residual 0.008687868263179943; 78 nonzero fitted weights. Neither this finite-chart miss nor the floating optimizer proves infeasibility.
